param_input_item.param_description: An N-by-2 cell array of {symbol, replacement} productions.

param_output_item.param_description: The expanded string, ready for a turtle interpretation.

description.p: Expand an L-system (Lindenmayer system) by repeatedly rewriting every symbol of the axiom with its production rule. L-systems model the recursive branching of plants and classic space-filling curves; the resulting string is typically fed to a turtle interpreter to draw.

xmldoc.bibliography: M. Hendrikx, S. Meijer, J. van der Velden, A. Iosup, Procedural Content Generation for Games: A Survey, ACM Transactions on Multimedia Computing, Communications and Applications 9(1), 2013. DOI 10.1145/2422956.2422957.
